variant.stem_override: A 28-year-old Hispanic or Latino woman with systemic lupus erythematosus diagnosed 4 years ago presents to clinic for preconception counseling. Her current SLE manifestations are mild to moderate skin and joint disease, and she has been clinically and serologically stable on hydroxychloroquine 400 mg/d, prednisone 5 mg/d, and methotrexate 15 mg/wk for the past 18 months (SLEDAI-2K consistently <4). She has no history of lupus nephritis, no antiphospholipid antibodies, no prior pregnancies. She is anti-Ro/SSA negative. Vital signs and labs are normal: BP 118/72, no proteinuria, normal complements, anti-dsDNA negative. She wishes to conceive in the next 6 months and is asking about medication adjustments.
